verdict.rationale: Temporal's own Archival feature moves closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records out to blob storage. The open-source server can be self-hosted (Docker, Kubernetes, or manual), which gives a path to leave. However, no evidence describes a full data export, the export formats, or a migration path off Temporal Cloud. Missing for 10: documented complete export of all data (including open/running workflows), explicit open/standard export formats, a Cloud-to-self-hosted migration or exit guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Archival: Move closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage for longer retention.
